decisions: The switch is global and applies to every cover, because library metadata is not a reliable content-classification source.
The reader page image remains visible; this is cover privacy, not content filtering.

CoverImageCache exposes Compose-observable masking state; enabling it evicts the shared LRU and prevents new cover loads from publishing cached images.
Home, library, tag results, detail cover, and the detail blurred cover background now use the same solid gray while enabled; reader page images remain unchanged.
Added localized resource strings for the switch title and summary.

SettingsScreen.kt persists and applies the global switch; strings.xml supplies its display text.
